title: Batch effects

blocks.what_we_do: Compare call rate by plate and remove the demonstrably faulty simulated plate.
blocks.why: Samples processed together can share artefacts. Compare laboratory grouping with genotype completeness and heterozygosity. A case-heavy plate must not be removed merely because it contains cases; the rationale here is the poor technical measurements. Reassess the case/control distribution after any batch exclusion.
blocks.you_need: State 3.6 and the sample sheet from 1.4; heterozygosity report from 3.5.
blocks.command:
```{r s3-7}
report <- guided_path(cfg, "3.7", "missing")
run_plink(cfg, c("--pfile", guided_path(cfg, "3.6"), "--missing", "sample-only", "--out", report))
missing <- guided_table(paste0(report, ".smiss"))
metadata <- guided_metadata(cfg)
plate <- metadata$Plate[match(missing$IID, metadata$IID)]
median_missing <- tapply(as.numeric(missing$F_MISS), plate, median)
print(sort(1 - median_missing))
worst <- names(which.max(median_missing))
stopifnot(worst == "P14")
remove_file <- guided_list(missing$IID[plate == worst], guided_path(cfg, "3.7", "remove.txt"), TRUE)
run_plink(cfg, c("--pfile", guided_path(cfg, "3.6"), "--remove", remove_file, "--make-pgen", "--out", guided_path(cfg, "3.7")))
ops <- guided_replay_lists(cfg, "3.7", "3.6")
guided_register(cfg, "3.7", "3.6", 1844, 296360, operations = ops)
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

```sh
bin/plink2 --pfile results/guided/s3-6_state --missing sample-only --out results/guided/s3-7_missing --threads 2 --memory 2048
bin/plink2 --pfile results/guided/s3-6_state --remove results/guided/s3-7_remove.txt --make-pgen --out results/guided/s3-7_state --threads 2 --memory 2048
```

`--missing sample-only` writes the per-well report without a variant report. R joins it to plates by IID, compares medians, and writes the reviewed removal list. `--pfile` selects the input native fileset; `--make-pgen` saves a new state; `--out` sets its prefix. The helper adds `--threads 2` and `--memory 2048`, limiting threads and workspace MiB.
blocks.expected_result:
Plate P14 has median call rate approximately 98.56%, against 99.84% for the other plates. Its 76 remaining wells are removed, leaving 1,844 samples and 296,360 variants.

The tested PLINK version is defined in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: executable chunks and instructor reference counts passed on Windows.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the named input and the previous step. Keep the command and console logs; do not substitute files from a different dataset version. See [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.what_this_check_can_reveal: A shared laboratory effect. The same pattern can confound association if processing groups and phenotype groups overlap.
blocks.quick_check:
Why are 76 wells removed from a plate that originally had 96?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

Some wells on that plate were already removed by earlier QC steps.

</details>
blocks.files_created: Sample missingness report, plate-based removal list and `s3-7_state.*`.

options.name: --remove
options.explanation_markdown: `--split-par b38` uses GRCh38 PAR boundaries. `--check-sex` compares recorded sex with genotype patterns; `max-female-xf` and `min-male-xf` set X-coefficient limits, while the two `ycount` limits bound observed Y calls. `--remove` reads the reviewed sample list. `--pfile` selects the input native fileset; `--make-pgen` saves a new state; `--out` sets its prefix. The helper adds `--threads 2` and `--memory 2048`, limiting threads and workspace MiB.
